pages.title: Multiverse Shard
pages.text: Matter from a universe whose constants are slightly different from ours. Its atoms are almost right, but the fine-structure constant is off by a hair, so its colour refuses to settle and its weight drifts as it adjusts to our physics. It feels like a stone that has not finished being a stone.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Through the Einstein-Rosen Bridge Projector, timed by a pulsar crystal, I reached into a neighbouring universe and pulled out a shard. Every piece I brought back let me reach further. Bulk monoliths also hold a few.
